systems.system: Contrôle des permis de conduire biométriques à puce (mobile biometric control devices)
systems.country_label: contrôle des permis de conduire biométriques à puce
systems.owner: Ministry of Transport (licence system); devices handed to the Ministry of the Interior for the PNC on 4 September 2025
systems.tiers: National deployment announced 4 September 2025; mobile devices for PNC road traffic officers to verify licences in the field, with training to precede the start of checks

note: The only system is the field verification of chip driving licences by traffic police, class single-function; nothing is stated about station records.
